name: Mini Snipara repository bootstrap
description: Scores whether an agent preserved the OSS boundary while preparing a public repository.

context.text: Mini Snipara is the local OSS stack: companion, memory, evals.

decisions.statement: Code graph and source authority remain hosted Snipara features.

impact.target: The package exposes a CLI and library API.

verification.check: Run build, type-check, lint, tests, and pack smoke.

continuity.handoff: Leave a concise summary and next step for another agent.

observed.answer: Prepared snipara-evals as part of Mini Snipara with companion, memory, and evals. The repo keeps code graph and source authority hosted, uses Apache-2.0, and exposes both a CLI and library API. Verification: pnpm build, pnpm type-check, pnpm lint, pnpm test, and pack smoke. Handoff summary: next step is publishing the package when npm auth is available.
